fields.description: Six residential clusters beside Masdar Central Park, bringing apartments, duplex penthouses and ground-access townhouses into one neighbourhood. The smaller junior one-bedroom layouts offer a different arrangement from the larger family homes.

research.locationNote: Masdar City, Abu Dhabi; the developer positions the six clusters beside Central Park.
overview: The 844-home programme includes 757 apartments, 42 penthouses and 45 townhouses.
research.priceNote: Bayut’s launch reference is approximately AED 755,000; Crompton Partners quotes AED 947,000. Neither establishes today’s available-unit price.
research.paymentNote: Tanami advertises 10% down and 1% monthly without a complete dated calendar. The remaining balance and applicable offer need confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Bayut anticipates Q4 2027; Crompton Partners quotes Q2 2027. No primary unit-specific date was verified.
